svg.title: Star schema: one fact table, three dimensions
svg.desc: FACT_TAXI_DEMAND holds one row per date and pickup location with trip_count, avg_fare, avg_tip, avg_tip_pct, avg_total, avg_distance and card_tip_pct. It joins DIM_TIME on DATE_ID, DIM_LOCATION on LOCATION_ID (132 JFK, 43 Central Park) and DIM_WEATHER on WEATHER_ID (rain, snow and temperature level).

text.font-family: Archivo, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
